changes: BR21 (new): ControlMailbox keeps ONE constant-size last-consumed-now high-water scalar (int|None, read-only property last_consumed_now_ns). Every consume call with structurally valid nonnegative now/slot and a valid caller age cap rejects now < last accepted clock (equality allowed) and records the new now before the pending candidate is inspected, so empty, evicted, aged-out, missed-slot and future-completion outcomes all establish the observed clock. Malformed arguments change no state; a regressed clock raises BrokerError and preserves the pending candidate, the ordering high-water key/digest and the retained history. No internal clock reads, no per-call history list, no implicit reset; a new binding requires a new mailbox. Main repro fixed: candidate completion 200 ns / sample lower 0; consume(500,100,1000) misses the slot and stays pending; consume(300,300,1000) now raises instead of returning it; a future completion is still retried at an equal or later valid clock, never earlier.

BR22 (new): the frozen profile observation age cap is a hard upper bound for consumption. consume retains age_limit_ns for stricter caller budgets but requires 0 < age_limit_ns <= PROFILE_LIMITS[binding.profile].observation_age_limit_ns (fast_9600 1.5 s / stress_300 12 s); an excessive value raises BrokerError even on an empty mailbox, before any clock state is recorded. Effective expiry is now >= sample_lower + age_limit. Main repro fixed: a fast_9600 candidate at sample lower 0 consumed at now 2 s with caller cap 10 s now raises; the same figures under a stress_300 binding remain legal.

BR23 (new): non-stop LeaseDeadline validates mode-scoped audit term names. HIL requires first_send_plus_original_ttl and sample_lower_plus_age_limit (optional receipt_plus_remaining_budget, previous_deadline); PC_DIRECT requires first_host_issue_plus_requested_duration and sample_lower_plus_age_limit (optional previous_deadline only). Unknown, missing, cross-mode and duplicate names and invalid ints raise BrokerError; deadline = min(terms) is unchanged and revalidated on every expired_at; stop state stays deadline None / empty terms / nonempty reason. The module and class docstrings document that a matching audit structure is not cryptographic provenance and never movement authorization. No extra data fields; the A public wire schema is untouched.

Preserved from recovery2 (semantically unchanged): persisted ordering high-water key/digest/completion metadata independent of the pending candidate lifetime; fail-closed clock consistency (sample lower at offer and consume, future completion rejected with the candidate retained); mandatory immutable uint64 sent_ordinal with at most 4 retained observations, idempotent exact duplicates, no re-registration of evicted ordinals and no wrap/restart in a binding; PROFILE_LIMITS read-only; BrokerBinding frozen profile names; sample_lower <= first_send/first_host_issue guards; unknown receipt bounds still stop.
Fail-closed convention (documented): clock-inconsistent inputs raise BrokerError; scheduling outcomes without a usable result return a Consumption with no candidate (reason != ok).
